feeds.description: Headquartered in New York, Curtis is a leading international law firm with 17 offices worldwide. The firm represents a variety of clients across a wide range of practice areas. Curtis' international outlook has been a hallmark of its practice since its founding in the 1830s. We offer a full range of domestic and international legal services in the fields of real estate, corporate and commercial law, banking, energy, arbitration, insurance, shipping and port development, tourism, employment and public procurement, amongst others.
